requirement: The system shall refuse entry to a vehicle when the target parking zone has no free spaces remaining.
The system shall compute the parking charge as the time parked multiplied by the hourly rate for the zone, with a daily cap applied.
The barrier controller scans the ticket; the system verifies the vehicle, opens the barrier and records the entry.
The driver pays at the pay station; the system validates the ticket, computes the charge, records payment and returns a valid exit voucher.
As a parking attendant, I want to record an overstay violation so that the vehicle owner can be invoiced for the penalty.
As a driver, I want to see my current parking session so that I know how long is remaining before expiry.
As a parking manager, I want to extend a session on behalf of a driver so that an overstay can be avoided when the driver is delayed.
A vehicle with an unpaid penalty invoice may not enter the parking facility until the invoice is settled or an arrangement is recorded.
Every entry, exit, extension and penalty event must be recorded with vehicle, zone, actor and time for reconciliation.
The ticket table shall ensure that issued and expiry times are consistent, that the vehicle plate is recorded, and that a paid ticket has a payment reference.

-- parking ticket table
CREATE TABLE parking_ticket (
    ticket_id           BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    ticket_code         VARCHAR(40)  NOT NULL,
    vehicle_plate       VARCHAR(20)  NOT NULL,
    zone_id             VARCHAR(20)  NOT NULL,
    issued_at           TIMESTAMP    NOT NULL,
    expires_at          TIMESTAMP    NOT NULL,
    status              VARCHAR(20)  NOT NULL,
    payment_reference   VARCHAR(80),
    CONSTRAINT ticket_code_unique     UNIQUE (ticket_code),
    CONSTRAINT ticket_plate_not_blank CHECK (length(trim(vehicle_plate)) > 0),
    CONSTRAINT ticket_times_order     CHECK (expires_at > issued_at),
    CONSTRAINT ticket_status_chk      CHECK (status IN ('ACTIVE','PAID','EXPIRED','CANCELLED')),
    CONSTRAINT ticket_paid_needs_ref  CHECK (status <> 'PAID' OR payment_reference IS NOT NULL)
);

CREATE INDEX ticket_vehicle_idx ON parking_ticket (vehicle_plate, issued_at DESC);
CREATE INDEX ticket_zone_idx    ON parking_ticket (zone_id, status);

-- parking zone table
CREATE TABLE parking_zone (
    zone_id        VARCHAR(20) PRIMARY KEY,
    name           VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    capacity       INTEGER      NOT NULL,
    hourly_rate    NUMERIC(8,2) NOT NULL,
    daily_cap      NUMERIC(8,2) NOT NULL,
    max_height_cm  INTEGER      NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT zone_capacity_positive CHECK (capacity > 0),
    CONSTRAINT zone_rate_positive     CHECK (hourly_rate > 0),
    CONSTRAINT zone_cap_positive      CHECK (daily_cap > 0)
);
-- penalty invoice table
CREATE TABLE penalty_invoice (
    invoice_id    BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    vehicle_plate VARCHAR(20)   NOT NULL,
    zone_id       VARCHAR(20)   NOT NULL,
    amount        NUMERIC(10,2) NOT NULL,
    reason        VARCHAR(80)   NOT NULL,
    issued_at     TIMESTAMP     NOT NULL,
    settled       BOOLEAN       NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    CONSTRAINT invoice_amount_positive CHECK (amount > 0)
);

requirement: Only parking attendants and administrators may issue penalty invoices; drivers must not be able to self-issue or cancel penalties.
The nightly reconciliation report shall show, for each zone, the number of entries, exits, total charges collected and penalties issued for the day.
